units.rawText: Incoming communications request.
units.displayText: Incoming communications request.

units.rawText: ...There's news! Hello, Mr. Secretary, this is Undine—
units.displayText: ...There's news! Hello, Mr. Secretary, this is Undine—

spans.text: ...There's news! Hello, Mr. Secretary, this is Undine—

units.rawText: Undine, make preparations. Someone will come pick you up soon.
units.displayText: Undine, make preparations. Someone will come pick you up soon.

spans.text: Undine, make preparations. Someone will come pick you up soon.

units.rawText: This is the first time you've not accompanied us to a performance. Where are we going?
units.displayText: This is the first time you've not accompanied us to a performance. Where are we going?

spans.text: This is the first time you've not accompanied us to a performance. Where are we going?

units.rawText: There's no performance this time; someone has bought you for a high price. Be on your best behavior, and don't cause us any problems.
units.displayText: There's no performance this time; someone has bought you for a high price. Be on your best behavior, and don't cause us any problems.

spans.text: There's no performance this time; someone has bought you for a high price. Be on your best behavior, and don't cause us any problems.

units.rawText: ...I understand.
units.displayText: ...I understand.

spans.text: ...I understand.

units.rawText: The secretary cuts the line and Undine stands up, her aides following closely behind.
units.displayText: The secretary cuts the line and Undine stands up, her aides following closely behind.

spans.text: The secretary cuts the line and Undine stands up, her aides following closely behind.

units.rawText: (Another change of hands... I should have known from the day I began idling instead of being of use to them.)
units.displayText: Another change of hands... I should have known from the day I began idling instead of being of use to them.

spans.text: Another change of hands... I should have known from the day I began idling instead of being of use to them.

units.rawText: Not that it really matters. After all... I'm just a Doll. Even if I do overstay my welcome, a new product will soon replace me, just like in that press conference.
units.displayText: Not that it really matters. After all... I'm just a Doll. Even if I do overstay my welcome, a new product will soon replace me, just like in that press conference.

spans.text: Not that it really matters. After all... I'm just a Doll. Even if I do overstay my welcome, a new product will soon replace me, just like in that press conference.

Beeeep— Didibeep—
(New command? Received. Transfer? Transfer?)
units.displayText:

(New command? Received. Transfer? Transfer?)

units.rawText: Pack our things, we're going to our new master's place.
units.displayText: Pack our things, we're going to our new master's place.

spans.text: Pack our things, we're going to our new master's place.

(Command, confirmed.)
units.displayText:
Didibeep—
(Command, confirmed.)

units.rawText: It's alright, it's not the end of the world. At least someone still has a use for me... We still have somewhere to go for now.
units.displayText: It's alright, it's not the end of the world. At least someone still has a use for me... We still have somewhere to go for now.

spans.text: It's alright, it's not the end of the world. At least someone still has a use for me... We still have somewhere to go for now.

units.rawText: On the way to the new owner's estate.
units.displayText: On the way to the new owner's estate.

spans.text: On the way to the new owner's estate.

units.rawText: ...Soften your movements; don't make any sound. Don't embarrass me in front of our new master.
units.displayText: ...Soften your movements; don't make any sound. Don't embarrass me in front of our new master.

spans.text: ...Soften your movements; don't make any sound. Don't embarrass me in front of our new master.

(Received, quiet!)
units.displayText:
Didibeeeep—
(Received, quiet!)

units.rawText: This way. Boss is waiting for you.
units.displayText: This way. Boss is waiting for you.

spans.text: This way. Boss is waiting for you.

units.rawText: Yes.
units.displayText: Yes.

spans.text: Yes.

units.rawText: Inside the estate, Undine immediately overhears the sounds of a spirited discussion between middle-aged men.
units.displayText: Inside the estate, Undine immediately overhears the sounds of a spirited discussion between middle-aged men.

spans.text: Inside the estate, Undine immediately overhears the sounds of a spirited discussion between middle-aged men.

units.rawText: For us to be operating on the scale we are now is chiefly thanks to you, Senator.
units.displayText: For us to be operating on the scale we are now is chiefly thanks to you, Senator.

spans.text: For us to be operating on the scale we are now is chiefly thanks to you, Senator.

units.rawText: You exaggerate, these are the fruits of your hard work. I merely followed the direction of the stream.
units.displayText: You exaggerate, these are the fruits of your hard work. I merely followed the direction of the stream.

spans.text: You exaggerate, these are the fruits of your hard work. I merely followed the direction of the stream.

units.rawText: But with the position I'm in, I face inconveniences at certain times with the affairs I want to take care of. We will have more chances to cooperate in the future, wouldn't you agree?
units.displayText: But with the position I'm in, I face inconveniences at certain times with the affairs I want to take care of. We will have more chances to cooperate in the future, wouldn't you agree?

spans.text: But with the position I'm in, I face inconveniences at certain times with the affairs I want to take care of. We will have more chances to cooperate in the future, wouldn't you agree?

units.rawText: Yes, yes, you're absolutely right. I can provide whatever fine Dolls you need.
units.displayText: Yes, yes, you're absolutely right. I can provide whatever fine Dolls you need.

spans.text: Yes, yes, you're absolutely right. I can provide whatever fine Dolls you need.

units.rawText: However... Could this performance by postponed a few days? You are an eminent guest, and we'd prefer to make further preparations. We would never have imagined that with you originally opposed to performing arts Dolls, we would suddenly...
units.displayText: However... Could this performance by postponed a few days? You are an eminent guest, and we'd prefer to make further preparations. We would never have imagined that with you originally opposed to performing arts Dolls, we would suddenly...

spans.text: However... Could this performance by postponed a few days? You are an eminent guest, and we'd prefer to make further preparations. We would never have imagined that with you originally opposed to performing arts Dolls, we would suddenly...

units.rawText: You... Mind yourself. Some questions are not meant to be asked.
units.displayText: You... Mind yourself. Some questions are not meant to be asked.

spans.text: You... Mind yourself. Some questions are not meant to be asked.

units.rawText: Now then, as you were saying. When is the performance?
units.displayText: Now then, as you were saying. When is the performance?

spans.text: Now then, as you were saying. When is the performance?

units.rawText: It... It'll be tomorrow, tomorrow. Or whenever you'd like, it'll be whenever you like!
units.displayText: It... It'll be tomorrow, tomorrow. Or whenever you'd like, it'll be whenever you like!

spans.text: It... It'll be tomorrow, tomorrow. Or whenever you'd like, it'll be whenever you like!

units.rawText: Hm—Where is the merchandise?
units.displayText: Hm—Where is the merchandise?

spans.text: Hm—Where is the merchandise?

units.rawText: Come in!
units.displayText: Come in!

spans.text: Come in!

units.rawText: Yes.
units.displayText: Yes.

spans.text: Yes.

units.rawText:
<size=28>Dididi, beeeep—
(Main unit, testing. Prompts, preparing.)</size>
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Main unit, testing. Prompts, preparing.)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Main unit, testing. Prompts, preparing.)

units.rawText: Oh, those are the Dolls. This look...
units.displayText: Oh, those are the Dolls. This look...

spans.text: Oh, those are the Dolls. This look...

units.rawText: Do you recognize them?
units.displayText: Do you recognize them?

spans.text: Do you recognize them?

units.rawText: Aren't these the star Dolls that Cyber Media put out not long ago? They were even on the news. Haha, looks like you've really paid the price.
units.displayText: Aren't these the star Dolls that Cyber Media put out not long ago? They were even on the news. Haha, looks like you've really paid the price.

spans.text: Aren't these the star Dolls that Cyber Media put out not long ago? They were even on the news. Haha, looks like you've really paid the price.

units.rawText: As it should be! If you have need of it, no matter how expensive or how outstanding, it'll all be prepared for you!
units.displayText: As it should be! If you have need of it, no matter how expensive or how outstanding, it'll all be prepared for you!

spans.text: As it should be! If you have need of it, no matter how expensive or how outstanding, it'll all be prepared for you!

units.rawText: Though these things... I've heard they used to perform for the big shots.
units.displayText: Though these things... I've heard they used to perform for the big shots.

spans.text: Though these things... I've heard they used to perform for the big shots.

units.rawText: This...
units.displayText: This...

spans.text: This...

units.rawText: What do you say, little one?
units.displayText: What do you say, little one?

spans.text: What do you say, little one?

units.rawText: (Calm down, calm down... This is one of our master's distinguished guests. I can't afford to slip up here, so just go with the answer prepared earlier.)
units.displayText: Calm down, calm down... This is one of our master's distinguished guests. I can't afford to slip up here, so just go with the answer prepared earlier.

spans.text: Calm down, calm down... This is one of our master's distinguished guests. I can't afford to slip up here, so just go with the answer prepared earlier.

units.rawText: (The visitors our previous master entertained used these pleasantries, too. If I just follow suit, then it'll all be fine.)
units.displayText: The visitors our previous master entertained used these pleasantries, too. If I just follow suit, then it'll all be fine.

spans.text: The visitors our previous master entertained used these pleasantries, too. If I just follow suit, then it'll all be fine.

units.rawText: Yes, you are correct. I do not perform for those without distinction. You are someone of great status, and a respected guest of my master.
units.displayText: Yes, you are correct. I do not perform for those without distinction. You are someone of great status, and a respected guest of my master.

spans.text: Yes, you are correct. I do not perform for those without distinction. You are someone of great status, and a respected guest of my master.

units.rawText: Master holds you in the highest regard. If you desire so, the Ceremonial Orchestra shall perform for you at any time.
units.displayText: Master holds you in the highest regard. If you desire so, the Ceremonial Orchestra shall perform for you at any time.

spans.text: Master holds you in the highest regard. If you desire so, the Ceremonial Orchestra shall perform for you at any time.

units.rawText: Huh—intriguing. Stars for a reason, I see.
units.displayText: Huh—intriguing. Stars for a reason, I see.

spans.text: Huh—intriguing. Stars for a reason, I see.

units.rawText: I shall look forward to your performance tomorrow, then.
units.displayText: I shall look forward to your performance tomorrow, then.

spans.text: I shall look forward to your performance tomorrow, then.

units.rawText: You may leave us.
units.displayText: You may leave us.

spans.text: You may leave us.

units.rawText: (Good... Thank goodness. With something like that from an important guest, surely our master won't toss us away.)
units.displayText: Good... Thank goodness. With something like that from an important guest, surely our master won't toss us away.

spans.text: Good... Thank goodness. With something like that from an important guest, surely our master won't toss us away.

units.rawText: With a grand salute alongside her aides, Undine lowers her head.
units.displayText: With a grand salute alongside her aides, Undine lowers her head.

spans.text: With a grand salute alongside her aides, Undine lowers her head.

units.rawText: We shall take our leave, then.
units.displayText: We shall take our leave, then.

spans.text: We shall take our leave, then.

units.displayText: Miscellaneous Storage.

spans.text: Miscellaneous Storage.

units.displayText: Cough, cough, cough... Blegh, it hurts...

units.rawText: I don't need your insincerities.
units.displayText: I don't need your insincerities.

spans.text: I don't need your insincerities.

Dididi, beeeep—
(Worried, worried.)

Dididi, beeeep—

Dididi, beeeep—
(Worried, worried.)

units.rawText: Shut up. It's useless for you all to keep beeping away over here and use up all my processing power in the end.
units.displayText: Shut up. It's useless for you all to keep beeping away over here and use up all my processing power in the end.

spans.text: Shut up. It's useless for you all to keep beeping away over here and use up all my processing power in the end.

units.rawText: Except for watching as I get snubbed and sharing in my glory, what can you do? You'd do better to take care of yourselves first.
units.displayText: Except for watching as I get snubbed and sharing in my glory, what can you do? You'd do better to take care of yourselves first.

spans.text: Except for watching as I get snubbed and sharing in my glory, what can you do? You'd do better to take care of yourselves first.

Dididi, beeeep—
(Sorry, we, leave...)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Sorry, we, leave...)

Dididi, beeeep—
(Sorry, we, leave...)

units.rawText: Leave? What can you do without me? You couldn't even get your hands on a bottle of fine instrument care oil!
units.displayText: Leave? What can you do without me? You couldn't even get your hands on a bottle of fine instrument care oil!

spans.text: Leave? What can you do without me? You couldn't even get your hands on a bottle of fine instrument care oil!

Dididi, beeeep—
(Instrument, oil. Instrument, oil.)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Instrument, oil. Instrument, oil.)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Instrument, oil. Instrument, oil.)

units.rawText: You can say that again when you can get ahold of it yourself.
units.displayText: You can say that again when you can get ahold of it yourself.

spans.text: You can say that again when you can get ahold of it yourself.

units.rawText: You can't even perform the basics properly. What more are you even good for...
units.displayText: You can't even perform the basics properly. What more are you even good for...

spans.text: You can't even perform the basics properly. What more are you even good for...

units.rawText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Phrasing, analyzing... Similarities, overwhelming.)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Phrasing, analyzing... Similarities, overwhelming.)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Phrasing, analyzing... Similarities, overwhelming.)

units.rawText: What? You're saying that I sound like that repulsive secretary? You—
units.displayText: What? You're saying that I sound like that repulsive secretary? You—

spans.text: What? You're saying that I sound like that repulsive secretary? You—

units.rawText: Undine seems to think of something, and her previously upright frame sinks down dejectedly.
units.displayText: Undine seems to think of something, and her previously upright frame sinks down dejectedly.

spans.text: Undine seems to think of something, and her previously upright frame sinks down dejectedly.

units.rawText: You guys... I don't want it to be this way either...
units.displayText: You guys... I don't want it to be this way either...

spans.text: You guys... I don't want it to be this way either...

units.rawText: It's painfully clear how much I've striven to work hard; I work even when I'm overloaded; I work even if I'm injured...
units.displayText: It's painfully clear how much I've striven to work hard; I work even when I'm overloaded; I work even if I'm injured...

spans.text: It's painfully clear how much I've striven to work hard; I work even when I'm overloaded; I work even if I'm injured...

units.rawText: Being tossed away by those in charge, being abandoned and thrown into storage—I have nothing left. Why?
units.displayText: Being tossed away by those in charge, being abandoned and thrown into storage—I have nothing left. Why?

spans.text: Being tossed away by those in charge, being abandoned and thrown into storage—I have nothing left. Why?

units.displayText: Warning, neural data disorder at 12% and rising.

units.rawText: The aides clumsily clean up the cooling fluid Undine spits out while Dolce bends down and tries to hug Undine.
units.displayText: The aides clumsily clean up the cooling fluid Undine spits out while Dolce bends down and tries to hug Undine.

spans.text: The aides clumsily clean up the cooling fluid Undine spits out while Dolce bends down and tries to hug Undine.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: (What even is this, I... don't need your sympathy, you...)
units.displayText: What even is this, I... don't need your sympathy, you...

spans.text: What even is this, I... don't need your sympathy, you...

units.rawText: (Going on and on about "not everything is lost, because we'll always be here for you"...Spouting niceties just like all of those bastards! If my value were to disappear, they'd leave me like the rest of them.)
units.displayText: Going on and on about "not everything is lost, because we'll always be here for you"...Spouting niceties just like all of those bastards! If my value were to disappear, they'd leave me like the rest of them.

spans.text: Going on and on about "not everything is lost, because we'll always be here for you"...Spouting niceties just like all of those bastards! If my value were to disappear, they'd leave me like the rest of them.

units.rawText: Undine takes a deep breath, allowing her core to cool before pushing Dolce away.
units.displayText: Undine takes a deep breath, allowing her core to cool before pushing Dolce away.

spans.text: Undine takes a deep breath, allowing her core to cool before pushing Dolce away.

units.rawText: Go prepare for tomorrow's performance.
units.displayText: Go prepare for tomorrow's performance.

spans.text: Go prepare for tomorrow's performance.

units.rawText: Cut it with the impossible platitudes. Go hibernate and don't be dead weight tomorrow.
units.displayText: Cut it with the impossible platitudes. Go hibernate and don't be dead weight tomorrow.
